what: Finding 1: stdout payload conflicts with quiet-init conventions
scenario_or_breakage: If the new renderer follows the normal lib-quiet pattern and calls larch_quiet_init, raw printf prompt output is redirected to the quiet log, so dispatchers capture empty prompt files and voters run without instructions
suggested_fix: Document and implement the renderer either as a pure stdout filter that does not call larch_quiet_init, or emit prompt lines through emit after init; add a quiet-enabled dispatcher harness assertion that rendered prompts are non-empty

what: Finding 2: plan voter verification permission is narrowed
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed plan-context branch says voters may read only the ballot file, removing the current permission to inspect the plan or referenced repo files; existing invariant tests also still require that allowance
suggested_fix: Preserve a plan-context Verify silently sentence allowing silent inspection of the plan and referenced repo files, and cover that exact branch in test-render-voter-prompt plus update or retain test-prompt-template-invariants

what: Finding 3: stub CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT lacks the new helper
scenario_or_breakage: The dispatch-plan harness points CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT at a minimal stub containing only scripts/dispatch-with-waterfall.sh; after make_prompt_file calls $PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/shared/scripts/render-voter-prompt.sh, healthy and retry scenarios fail before launching voters
suggested_fix: Update the harness stub to include the shared renderer and lib-quiet dependency, or refactor the test to stub only dispatch-with-waterfall via an override while keeping CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT at the real repo root

what: Finding 4: canonical OOS drift guard does not cover two required copies
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says four copies are kept in sync, but the proposed drift test only greps helper output and skills/shared/voting-protocol.md; the design and implement MAV clauses can drift while CI stays green
suggested_fix: Extend case_canonical_text_drift_guard to grep the exact canonical clause in skills/design/SKILL.md and skills/implement/SKILL.md as well as voting-protocol.md

what: Finding 5: modified dispatch script contracts omit sibling doc updates
scenario_or_breakage: The plan changes prompt ownership and voter instructions in dispatch-plan-voters.sh and dispatch-code-voters.sh but does not update their sibling .md contracts, leaving future contributors with stale integration guidance
suggested_fix: Add updates for scripts/dispatch-plan-voters.md and scripts/dispatch-code-voters.md, and update the relevant test sibling docs if their asserted prompt invariants change
